crossRefs.note: Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his…
I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”
for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her…

parallels.note: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

translations.web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
translations.bsb: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
translations.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
translations.asv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
